manifest.category_selection: Human excludes Faces/Motorbikes/airplanes based on prior development failure; preserve other17 classes. Choose exactly3 replacements from >=60-photo pool using original fixed train-only RGB16/finite-difference centroids and validation elimination, never replacement test pixels or optical test scores. Existing train/val IDs pinned; no previous fitting/validation sample enters new test. New task remains development; do not retroactively rescore old tests.
manifest.preprocessing: Full RGB photograph; EXIF transpose, bicubic150; unchanged fixed optical amplitude encoding
manifest.limitations: Human exclusions follow observed development results. Fixed train/val thumbnail screen picks only three replacements, all17 remaining classes preserved. This is a changed development task, not an independent held-out accuracy claim or a controlled comparison with old20.

selection_summary.selection_source: Fixed train/val thumbnail; exclusion informed by prior development
